description: Conversion of existing semi-detached dwelling into a large House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) (Sui Generis) for 11 persons in 11 rooms, with associated part single/part two-storey side and rear extensions, loft extension via front and rear dormers, creation of front and Rear Lightwells  and provision of refuse storage, secure cycle parking, and private amenity space.
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of poor outlook and sunlight/daylight, would provide a sub-standard form of accommodation at basement level to the detriment of future occupiers, contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP17 (Housing Design) and LP22 (Houses in Multiple Occupation) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).

The provided bicycle parking lacks detail and would not be considered an accessible or acceptable location. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policy LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policy T5 (Cycling) of the London Plan (2021).

The applicant has failed to show any waste storage solutions for refuse and recycling at the property, and therefore, the proposal fails to meet the requirements set out in policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP57 (Waste) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policy SI 7 (Reducing waste and supporting the circular economy) of the London Plan (2021).

In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The application is, therefore, contrary to policy LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and policy T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan (2021).

The proposed ground-floor rear extension, at 3.5m tall, and south of the attached neighbour, would harm the amenities of the occupiers of No.44 through a loss of daylight and sunlight, and it would have an overbearing impact. As such, the proposal fails to comply with policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).

By reason of insufficient and incorrect information submitted on both the application form and drawings regarding the existing property, the local planning authority cannot fully assess the proposed use as a large HMO (Sui Generis Use).&nbsp;

In the absence of an Energy Statement, or&nbsp; Unilateral Undertaking or Section 106 securing a financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, the development fails to demonstrate how it meets policies LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change)&nbsp;of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and policies <span id="docs-internal-guid-41b70327-7fff-804e-4a41-5ab165241d1a">SI 2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) and SI 4 (Managing heat risk) of the London Plan (2021).<div><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div></span>

<p>The proposed HMO accommodation, by reason of its inadequate layout, insufficiently sized kitchens for the number of occupiers, and lack of information submitted on head heights throughout the building, fails to demonstrate that it meets the requirements of policy LP22 Part A v of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).&nbsp; Furthermore, no evidence has been submitted to demonstrate how the proposed rent levels would be suitable for people with low incomes, as required by LP22 Part A iv, nor have evidence of management arrangements and details of the proposed length of tenancy agreements been provided, as required by LP22 Part B of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</p>
